method: Independent two-dimensional high-precision root solve of incomplete-beta CDF(r)=1/2 and (1-m)*(alpha-1)-m*(beta-1)=0. Double-precision prototype results supply only starting guesses. No production solver evaluations are used. Four additional known-shape cases use high-precision median bisection directly from the specified shapes.
input_representation: IEEE754 binary64 input values promoted exactly to arbitrary precision.
